$comment: Provenance of this native fork; scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs reads it. Local delta includes observable shell.main centre ownership, delegated keyed-main rendering with native fallback, the shell.beforeMain seat above the main surface (the main-tabs strip, which may hide the mounted main surface), a frame-lifetime dock action registry, retained hidden dock views and a hidden native resource carrier throughout Workbench mode, and full-height right geometry with the bottom row confined to left plus centre, and an added status strip (StatusStrip.tsx) the frame renders under the columns, which apply() receives decorated so it reads the frame settings (hidden items, order) and wraps items that declare open in a button; the phone pill drops the label of an item with summaryLabel: false and skips content marked data-status-detail (polish pass b:r4et). The strip is a labelled group (role group, "Status"), not a live region; on the phone shell its pill row is 46px with the kit's dshx-hit-44 on the pill, grows by the bottom safe area when no tab bar sits below it and starts on a hairline (round five P3), with the phone shell's navigation that row shows only while an item marks data-status-actionable, status otherwise opening from the top bar's PhoneStatus button, which renders StatusSheetList from what the strip measured (round five C2); the frame pads the left and right safe areas, and hover tints sit behind (hover: hover) (round four item 19). An untouched sidebar (no width dragged or stored; stores.ts sidebarCustom, frame-widths stores 0 for it) opens at 312px on a frame 1440px or wider, 280px below (columns.ts SidebarDefaultModel, round five B4). The root registration also leaves a childless placeholder on the root context while the bundle hot-reloads (src/root-handoff.ts), so 'root' never renders without a registration. Update it with every upstream bump or delta change.
